main.description: A single emote belonging to an emote pack.

name.description: Short name used to reference this emote in chat. Should be alphanumeric with underscores only.

image.description: The emote image. Square images recommended.

alt.description: Alt text for the emote image.

creator.description: DID of the creator/artist of this emote, if different from the pack author.

pack.description: AT-URI of the place.stream.emote.pack record this emote belongs to.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this emote was created.
